chip: GROWTH BLUEPRINT OS · BULLSEYE + REVENUE OVERLAY
title: where the channel *aims*, priced
dek: Five rings derived by named constraint relaxation, a 3-2-1 content mix with a chaos dart, and the layer the niche never ships: every bucket wired to the $750/$2,500 offer ladder with a dollar-defined kill-or-keep rule answerable by batch three.

sections.heading: define, hit, expand
sections.body: The center is one person: the founder-formulator of an already-selling supplement or performance brand under $15M with a dated launch occasion inside 60-90 days, who keeps buying mechanisms to avoid an unmade message decision. Each ring outward drops exactly one named filter - the launch clock, then the category, then the regulated-claims constraint, then everything. Rings are auditable decisions, not vibes: you can argue about which filter comes off first. The batch shape is 3-2-1: two narrow buckets at Ring 2 (trust and conversion), one broad at Ring 4 (reach, fenced), one chaos dart. Ring 5 gets a warning band, not a bucket.

sections.heading: the five rings
sections.caption: each step drops ONE named constraint

steps.title: Ring 1 - the center
steps.note: Supplement/performance founder, $1M-$15M, dated occasion in 60-90 days. 15 researched, 7 verified profiles. DM territory, never a content lane.

steps.title: Ring 2 - drop the launch clock
steps.note: Operating category founders without a live occasion. Converts: teardown to $750 Angle Map. Competition thin: Chew On This (no breakouts), Marketing Operators (13.3K).

steps.title: Ring 3 - drop the category
steps.note: Claims-constrained health brands: skincare, functional foods, devices. Longer nurture to the same ladder. Common Thread Collective operates here (14.2x CPG row).

steps.title: Ring 4 - drop regulated-claims
steps.note: All DTC founders with paid-acquisition pain. Reach engine only; feeds inner rings by recognition. Heavy competition: 147K-928K sub channels.

steps.title: Ring 5 - drop everything
steps.note: Anyone into marketing/business/AI. Hormozi's 4.44M gravity. Craft-only zone; a viral hit here teaches the algorithm the wrong audience.

rows.claim: The Defensible Claim (Ring 2, conversion) - the W1 lane bucket
rows.evidence: Feeds the Sprint via the Angle Map. Working = at least 2 DMs/comments per batch from operating founders mentioning claims, launch, or proof. Kill/keep: below 2 across batches 2-3, swap in Launch Math; at 4+, add a third slot. Lead value ~$300/qualified inquiry on the stated assumption base
rows.source_label: assumption base: $750 x 20% + $2,500 x 20% x 30% - real rates [NEED], 0 sends logged

rows.claim: The Counter Files (Ring 2, trust) - the proof register no incumbent can copy
rows.evidence: Vitamin Shoppe counter + 18-year practitioner history as buyer-side embodied proof. Working = at least 1 'this is exactly my buyer' reply per batch. Kill/keep: below 1 across 2-3 batches, swap in The Convert
rows.confidence: VERIFIED as strategy, LIKELY as economics

rows.claim: The Fix Aisle (Ring 4, reach) - honestly flagged reach-only
rows.evidence: Rides the niche's proven news-jack skeleton (64.2x ceiling receipt, mywifequitherjob) to install the decision-before-mechanism belief. $0 direct lead value claimed. Working = one 3x+ breakout per two batches AND 30%+ of engagers identifiably Rings 2-4

rows.claim: Chaos dart, batch 1: ChatGPT built the same supplement brand ten times
rows.evidence: Demonstrates the sameness machine instead of describing it. A win teaches whether demonstration outperforms telling. Tagged W1+W3; the reserve holds four more candidates, each wild in a different way
rows.source_label: chaos reserve, pre-screened against the whitespace map

sections.heading: the rules printed on the tracker
sections.dek: Decisions in dollars and counts, never vibes.

items.action: No verdict on any video inside 24 hours
items.why: Maturity rule carried from the source system; early numbers lie
Two to three batches is the minimum signal for a kill/keep call

items.action: Count conversions in 'working =' units logged in his own inbox
items.why: He logs his own sends and DMs; every threshold above is observable without a dashboard
Topics from the bucket's own ring, craft from anywhere - sourcing topics from Ring 5 is how channels drift generic

sections.heading: what is assumed, *said out loud*
sections.body: Close rates are assumptions (20% inquiry-to-Map, 30% Map-to-Sprint) flagged [NEED] until the first ten sends log outcomes. Ring sizes are subscriber-count proxies, not measured audiences; a keyword-volume pull would harden them. Velocity fields in this pack are unreadable (snapshots 64 minutes apart). The center's pipeline numbers (15 researched, 7 verified, 0 sent) are his own logged facts.
